expression_restriction.value: natural closed-mouth expression; eyes open, gazing directly forward; no profile shots

glasses_policy.value: colored sunglasses prohibited (exception: visually impaired); no glare or reflection on glasses lenses

face_visibility.value: face must be clearly identifiable; frontal view required; shoulder line must be visible

accessories.value: eye patches, bandages, adhesive tape prohibited

size.evidence: Official Ministry of the Interior and Safety (mois.go.kr) confirms 3.5cm x 4.5cm for 주민등록증 photos. The site also notes '여권 사진 규격으로 촬영하면 주민등록증과 여권 발급 시 모두 사용 가능' (passport photo specs work for both ID and passport). Also independently confirmed by visafoto.com at 35mm x 45mm. Fetched from https://www.mois.go.kr/frt/sub/a06/b06/IDCard_5/screen.do
